name: opencode-notify
description: System popups with actionable buttons for Opencode

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external powertoast --external node-dbus-notifier --external detect-terminal --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && bun run build:native

opencode.name: opencode-notify
opencode.description: Native OS notifications with actionable buttons
